name: lab591-dev-bridge-admin
description: Admin interface of the Lab591 Dev Bridge WordPress plugin (build-time only: the plugin ships the compiled files in build/).

scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && wp-scripts lint-js ./admin/src && wp-scripts lint-style "admin/src/**/*.scss"
scripts.i18n: wp i18n make-pot . languages/lab591-dev-bridge.pot --slug=lab591-dev-bridge --domain=lab591-dev-bridge --exclude=node_modules,admin,vendor,tests,tools,dist && node tools/translations/make-po.mjs it_IT && wp i18n make-mo languages && wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge
